subject.title: [Feature]: Mobile apps: read-only workspace file browser (browse, preview, share)

question: Should OpenClaw accept a read-only `agents.workspace.*` file-read boundary for mobile now, and if so should it land through the stacked gateway/iOS/Android PRs or the all-in-one contributor PR?
rationale: This is not a narrow bug fix: it adds a new gateway file-read surface and mobile UI over workspace contents, which requires maintainer product and security intent even though the requested shape is well scoped.

options.title: Land stacked read-only path
options.body: Review and land the gateway RPC PR first, then retarget/review the iOS and Android PRs against that additive contract.

options.title: Consolidate into one PR
options.body: Ask one branch to become the canonical implementation, but require the same security proof and mobile real-behavior proof before merge.

options.title: Defer to broader workspace API
options.body: Keep this issue blocked on the broader workspace CRUD design if maintainers do not want a separate read-only slice.

recommendation.title: Land stacked read-only path
recommendation.body: Review and land the gateway RPC PR first, then retarget/review the iOS and Android PRs against that additive contract.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the issue and the stacked candidate PRs and has the strongest recent history across the mobile and gateway surfaces involved.
